description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S installment options, current available sizes, the official Sector S plan and WhatsApp plot checks.

body:
## Installment option in Sector S

Sector S is currently an installment sector. Ask for the latest payment schedule and current available plot numbers before comparing it with a cash-only model block.

## Sector S plan and plot position

Use the official Sector S plan to understand road widths, plot dimensions and the exact position of an offered plot. Ask for the current plot number marked on the plan before you shortlist.

## Compare with Sector T

Both Sector S and Sector T are installment options. Sector T currently has a confirmed 5.56 Marla offer at PKR 27.90 Lac, while Sector S should be checked for its current available sizes and payment schedule.

## Compare with the model blocks

Sector O, P, Q and R are currently cash-only model blocks. If you prefer installments, compare Sector S with Sector T rather than assuming the model-block cash price can be paid over time.

## Before you proceed

Confirm the exact plot, current installment schedule, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process before making a material payment.
